g1.label: 1. Peoples who lived in a place first
g1.why: Indigenous describes the peoples who lived in a place before later settlers arrived.

g2.label: 2. A formal agreement
g2.why: A treaty is a formal agreement between groups or governments.

g3.label: 3. Passes on stories and knowledge
g3.why: An elder is an older, respected member of a community who passes on knowledge.

g4.label: 4. Repairing relationships after harm
g4.why: Reconciliation means restoring good relations after conflict or harm.

g5.label: 5. Peoples connected to a ___
g5.why: A territory is an area of land; a land acknowledgement names whose land it is.

g6.label: 6. Each ___ has a responsibility
g6.why: A generation is all the people born around the same time.

g7.label: 7. A strong ___
g7.why: A community is a group of people who live together and support each other.

g8.label: 8. Carries history and humour
g8.why: A language carries a people's history, humour and way of seeing the world.

g1.label: 1. Languages ___ again
g1.why: Present progressive passive (are being + past participle) for something happening now.

g2.label: 2. The orange shirt ___
g2.why: Present passive with a singular subject: is + past participle.

g3.label: 3. Land acknowledgements ___
g3.why: Plural subject, general fact: present passive 'are used'.

g4.label: 4. Stories ___ from elders
g4.why: Present perfect passive: have been + past participle, from the past up to now.

g5.label: 5. More resources ___
g5.why: Passive after a modal: should + be + past participle.

g6.label: 6. Students ___ to listen
g6.why: Past passive with a plural subject: were + past participle.

g7.label: 7. A cultural centre ___ last year
g7.why: 'Last year' needs the past passive; singular subject + was opened.

g8.label: 8. Difficult history ___
g8.why: Passive after a modal: must + be + past participle.
